{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(df.shape)
df.head(3)

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"Number of -999 sentinel values in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}")

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_duplicates = df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {patient_id_duplicates}")

# Check sample_seq distribution
print("Max sample_seq per patient:")
df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().value_counts().sort_index()"}
